# Researching and ingesting wiki evidence

Choose the mode explicitly from the request. An unspecified request to use this
role is not permission to process the whole backlog; clarify the intended task.
Treat `` as the request when the host has not substituted it.

- **Discover sources on a topic:** read [discovery](references/discover.md),
  [access](../wiki-maintainer/references/access.md),
  [evidence](../wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md), and
  [efficacy](../wiki-maintainer/references/efficacy.md). Research perspectives
  return candidates without writing. Use the capture route only within the
  requested scope; a request for candidates alone remains read-only.
- **Capture named URLs or saved web pages:** read [named capture](references/capture.md)
  and [access](../wiki-maintainer/references/access.md). Skip broad topic research;
  preserve deduplication, declines and capture checks.
- **Capture a named format or service:** read its complete route:
  [PDF](references/clip-pdf.md), [Word](references/clip-docx.md),
  [PowerPoint](references/clip-pptx.md), [spreadsheets](references/clip-xlsx.md),
  [GitHub repository](references/clip-gh.md), or
  [Confluence](references/clip-confluence.md). These routes include prerequisite
  checks; missing converters or authentication never justify fabricated evidence.
- **Ingest named existing clippings:** read [ingestion](references/ingest.md),
  [access](../wiki-maintainer/references/access.md), and
  [evidence](../wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md). Use the exact source set;
  do not rediscover it or silently expand to the global backlog.
- **Process new or un-ingested clippings without a filename:** read
  [ingestion](references/ingest.md) and the
  [hash-join backlog contract](../wiki-maintainer/references/maintenance.md).
  Determine eligibility before writing. Preserve already summarized sources and
  reject restricted evidence as support. If nothing eligible is pending, report
  that without opening an operation, logging, committing or refreshing indexes.

Capture-only requests create evidence, never derived source or concept pages.
Ingestion needs authorization for that source set; an explicitly requested full
research-and-ingest flow already provides it. Only capture tools write raw
artifacts, and agents never edit their bodies. Read
[evidence](../wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md) before assessing fidelity,
quoting or synthesizing; preserve restrictions and platform-specific sections.

Before the first authorized mutation, read
[operation completion](../wiki-maintainer/references/operations.md). Finish the
scoped validation, log, commit, sync and remote verification unless publication
is held. Reuse an enclosing operation when it owns the work; preserve other
writers' edits. For concept reuse and relationship changes read
[efficacy](../wiki-maintainer/references/efficacy.md).
Mode is "ingest named existing clippings". I'll read the three references that mode requires.

1	# Ingest captured evidence
2	
3	Read [access and host commands](../../wiki-maintainer/references/access.md) before touching the vault. Also read for this operation: [evidence](../../wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md).
4	Load the rest only when this run reaches it — [efficacy](../../wiki-maintainer/references/efficacy.md) before creating or merging a concept, alias or relationship; [maintenance](../../wiki-maintainer/references/maintenance.md) when you compute the backlog with the content-hash join, or hit a structural repair.
5	Before the first authorized write, follow the shared operations completion contract; reuse existing session authorization.
6	
7	## Select eligible work before opening an operation
8	
9	For an explicit request to process new/un-ingested clippings without a filename,
10	run `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs" --backlog`. The **not ingested
11	(no summary records their hash)** list is the starting set. This source-hash join,
12	including its documented legacy fallback, is authoritative for membership; do
13	not infer backlog from filenames, navigation citations or a successful exit.
14	An unspecified request to use the researcher role is not a request to ingest all.
15	
16	For named clippings, resolve and read those exact paths only. Check the same
17	hash-join report and the existing source summaries before doing work: if a source
18	page already records that clipping's `source-hash`, preserve it and report already
19	ingested. A rerun creates no duplicate summary or unearned second ingestion.
20	An explicit request to revise an existing summary can update that canonical page;
21	do not expand named ingestion to unrelated backlog or broad discovery.
22	
23	Inspect each selected clipping's metadata before treating it as support. Exclude
24	`citation-status: quarantined`, `restricted` or `retired` evidence, preserving its
25	raw bytes and restriction; report it separately rather than summarizing it as
26	accepted support. A missing source hash is a repair issue, not permission to
27	invent one. Binary originals and figure sidecars are not summary targets. The
28	helper's backlog can include restricted or defective captures, so its count is
29	not automatically the count of eligible work.
30	
31	If the backlog is zero, every named source is already summarized, or no eligible
32	source remains, stop and report the actual result and any exclusions. Do not
33	create pages, open operations, log, commit or refresh indexes. For work that
34	remains, retain the exact eligible set and initial hash-join membership. See
35	[backlog semantics](../../wiki-maintainer/references/maintenance.md) for migration
36	and repair cases; structural repair still needs its own authorized scope.
37	
38	## Ingest and complete the selected set
39	
40	Read [operation completion](../../wiki-maintainer/references/operations.md)
41	before the first authorized write.
42	
43	**Open the operation first:** `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/op-begin.mjs" --op ingest`
44	This records what was already uncommitted, so the commit at the end contains your
45	work and not the user's in-progress writing. Close it in step 6.
46	
47	**Keep the ledger as you go.** Record each page you write (`wiki/sources/...`, a concept
48	or synthesis you create or change) with
49	`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/op-ledger.mjs" add --since <token> <path>...`, and give
50	`--since <token>` to `index-gen.mjs` and `log-entry.mjs`. When this ingest follows a discover
51	run, take the clipping set from that run's ledger file (its `raw/clippings/...` entries), not
52	from `git show`. Delegated writers get the parent token in their brief and run the same `add`
53	for the pages they write; they never close the operation (see the operations reference).
54	
55	Prefer a named clipping set; two concurrent ingests can overwrite shared concept
56	pages, so coordinate overlapping targets rather than processing the global backlog
57	in parallel. Update only pages substantively changed by the evidence.
58	
59	Apply the [Reddit and Medium evidence policy](../../wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md#reddit-and-medium)
60	to every page you write: Reddit-derived content belongs under
61	`## Reddit discussion (anecdotal)` and Medium-derived content under
62	`## Medium articles`, including when updating a mixed-source page.
63	
64	For each eligible source, perform steps 1–3 and preserve raw body bytes. After
65	the selected batch, perform steps 4–6 once so the operation has one log and commit:
66	1. Read the exact clipping through the guarded CLI or filesystem. Write derived
67	   Markdown through exact-path filesystem edits, never a whole CLI `content=` payload. Discuss
68	   the key takeaways with the user.
69	2. Write/update `wiki/sources/<slug>.md`: a summary with `sources: ["[[<raw link>]]"]`,
70	   `type: source`, `ai-generated: true`, and typed `created`/`updated`/`reviewed`.
71	   **Always quote each wikilink inside the list — `sources: ["[[A]]", "[[B]]"]`,
72	   never a bare `sources: [[A]]` or an unquoted block list (`- [[A]]`).** Both
73	   unquoted shapes look correct and Obsidian still renders the links, but neither
74	   is valid YAML: `[[A]]` is flow-sequence syntax one level too many and silently
75	   parses into a nested list instead of a string, which is exactly the "type
76	   mismatch, expected list" defect `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/repair-inline-sources.mjs"`
77	   exists to repair in bulk. Quoting is what makes it an unambiguous string.
78	   **Cite the clipping by its actual filesystem path — `sources: ["[[raw/clippings/<exact filename>.md]]"]` — copied from the path you just read, never retyped from
79	   the source's title.** The clipper slugifies a title into a filename (`/`, `:`,
80	   `#`, `*`, `?`, quotes and brackets all become `-`, then a 120-char cap), so any
81	   title carrying one of those characters or running long does NOT name its own
82	   file. Citing the remembered title produces a link to a file that does not exist:
83	   the page becomes a `provenanceGap` and its clipping reads as unparsed, even
84	   though the ingest itself was correct. List the resolved vault's exact `raw/clippings/` directory or reuse the path
85	   from step 1 rather than reconstructing it.
86	   Also record `source-hashes: [<sha256>, …]` — the `source-hash` frontmatter value
87	   of each clipping you summarized (read it from the clipping's frontmatter). This
88	   is the machine key the ingest-backlog metric joins on — immune to filename and
89	   citation drift; the `sources: ["[[…]]"]` wikilink stays for navigation.
90	   To repair vaults that already drifted this way:
91	   `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/repair-provenance-links.mjs"` (dry run) then `--apply`.
92	   **Figures.** If the clipping's frontmatter lists `figures:`, open each sidecar
93	   (`raw/figures/<slug>-p<N>.md`) and **look at the PNG with the Read tool** before
94	   writing. Embed the ones that carry evidence on the source page as
95	   `![[raw/figures/<slug>-p<N>.png]]` next to the claim they support, with a sentence
96	   saying what the figure shows (axes, series, trend) taken from what you see, not from
97	   the machine description. A page render is a whole page: say which part matters.
98	   Quote numbers read off a chart as approximate and attribute them. If the PDF has
99	   figures but no `figures:`, tell the user `clip-pdf.mjs --figures-only` can add them.
100	   Never edit or add to `raw/figures/`.
101	3. Before creating a concept, search the proposed title, equivalent wording and
102	   nearby passages. Extend the canonical page, add a genuinely equivalent alias,
103	   or explain the new concept's distinct scope. Use `_templates/concept-note.md`;
104	   follow the directly linked efficacy reference for aliases and relationships.
105	   Create a stub (`status: stub`) only for an identified gap. Explain each useful
106	   connection under `## Relationships`; keep supporting citations in `sources:`
107	   and the relevant prose. Relatedness does not establish support. Update the
108	   task map the new knowledge helps answer. Preserve `reviewed` on pages that
109	   received only metadata/link edits; stamp it only after factual verification.
110	4. Regenerate the catalog: `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/index-gen.mjs"`
111	   (never hand-edit index.md's generated fence). With another writer in the vault,
112	   add `--paths-file <ledger>` (the JSON array of pages this ingest wrote, from
113	   `op-ledger.mjs show --since <token> --out <ledger>`) so their
114	   uncommitted pages stay out of the catalog and their lines already in it stay in. Write the log entry by piping the
115	   narrative to `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/log-entry.mjs" --op ingest --title "<title>" --since <token>`
116	   (creates `log/<timestamp>-ingest-<slug>.md` in the resolved vault).
117	5. Never edit anything under `raw/`. Validate the derived pages' exact citation
118	   targets, source hashes, frontmatter and supported claims. Rerun
119	   `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs" --backlog` and compare the actual
120	   hash-join membership with the initial set. Eligible sources just summarized
121	   should leave that set; restricted captures do not become ingested by exclusion.
122	   Confirm already summarized sources and raw bodies remain unchanged.
123	6. **Close the operation:**
124	   Run `op-ledger.mjs show --since <saved-token> --out <ledger>` and read what it lists as
125	   unclaimed (another writer's pages, or one of yours you did not record), then
126	   `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/op-commit.mjs" --op ingest --title "<what you ingested>" --since <saved-token> --paths-file <ledger>`
127	   Commits exactly the pages this ingest touched, as one revertable unit, and
128	   reports anything it deliberately left alone. Without `--paths-file` the close is refused while another operation is open. Then follow the shared completion contract to push your updates (`wiki-sync.mjs`, or `wiki-sync.mjs --op <saved-token> --paths-file <ledger> --title "<what you ingested>"` to close and push in one command) and verify remote publication. If the sync is refused because uncommitted edits overlap incoming changes (exit 3), read "Refused sync" in the [operations reference](../../wiki-maintainer/references/operations.md): never reset, check out, stash or delete a file you did not write.

1	# Vault access and host commands
2	
3	Resolve the plugin root from the installed `SKILL.md` location, not the current
4	working directory: its containing skill folder's `../../` is the plugin root.
5	From a file in a skill's `references/` folder, use `../../../` instead.
6	Resolve and quote absolute helper paths before running commands. Treat
7	`$ARGUMENTS` as the user's request when the host has not substituted it. A linked
8	skill or reference can be read directly when the host has no skill loader; shared
9	policy does not require loading the maintenance-role entry point.
10	Resolve `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT` (default `~/.wiki-master-vault`; with `WIKI_MASTER_REQUIRE_VAULT=1` set and no vault named, a script stops with exit 2 instead of using the default) and verify the expected
11	vault layout. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and
12	filesystem access are sufficient for the supported operations below; do not ask
13	the user to restart Obsidian as a prerequisite for all work.
14	
15	## Layout and read scope
16	
17	`raw/clippings/` holds captured evidence; `wiki/{sources,entities,concepts,syntheses,authored}/`
18	holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per
19	operation. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it. Reads do not
20	open operations, write logs, commit or refresh indexes. Before any authorized
21	mutation, read [operation completion](operations.md); before quoting or
22	synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).
23	
24	Prefer bounded search and relevant MOCs to the generated catalog. Search
25	diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
26	Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
27	distinct from factual review dates.
28	
29	## Choose the supported channel
30	
31	| Operation | Channel and fallback |
32	|---|---|
33	| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
34	| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |
35	| Health, evidence routes, identity, relationships, drift coverage | Bundled filesystem helpers work without Obsidian. Do not gate them on `assertRunning`. Drift embeddings still require their backend. |
36	| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
37	| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
38	| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
39	| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |
40	
41	For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
42	or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
43	agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
44	`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
45	The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
46	Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
47	to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.
48	This policy is not Obsidian's documented maximum. If rejected before sending,
49	use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note
50	into many CLI writes or disable the guard. No fallback performs writes implicitly.
51	After an unavailable CLI or timeout, choose the supported fallback once; never
52	loop waiting for the app. **A timed-out mutation has an uncertain outcome.** Read
53	the exact target and check the intended effect before retrying or switching to
54	filesystem writes. An exit or timeout alone does not establish that nothing ran.
55	OS cleanup releases a lock after process death, but cannot prove a surviving CLI
56	child or an already-submitted Obsidian mutation finished. Inspect uncertain targets.
57	
58	Validate resolved paths stay under the known root. Restrict searches to explicit
59	content directories; exclude `.recycle/`, dot folders, dependency trees and binary
60	originals. Do not recursively enumerate the entire user profile or scan a recycled
61	topic. Raw bodies remain immutable even during fallback. If target content changed
62	since it was read, reconcile it before writing; do not overwrite concurrent work.
63	
64	## Shell portability
65	
66	Examples elsewhere use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs"` as command
67	notation. Replace the placeholder with the actual installed absolute path before
68	execution, and set the vault for the operation's scope. Do not execute literal
69	angle-bracket placeholders or assume a relative `scripts/` path means the plugin.
70	
71	PowerShell (restore any prior environment value):
72	
73	```powershell
74	$wikiPriorVault = $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT
75	try {
76	  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = 'C:/absolute/path/to/vault'
77	  node 'C:/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
78	  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Wiki health failed' }
79	} finally {
80	  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = $wikiPriorVault
81	}
82	```
83	
84	POSIX shell (one command's environment only):
85	
86	```sh
87	WIKI_MASTER_VAULT='/absolute/path/to/vault' node '/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
88	```
89

# Vault access and host commands

Resolve the plugin root from the installed `SKILL.md` location, not the current
working directory: its containing skill folder's `../../` is the plugin root.
From a file in a skill's `references/` folder, use `../../../` instead.
Resolve and quote absolute helper paths before running commands. Treat
`$ARGUMENTS` as the user's request when the host has not substituted it. A linked
skill or reference can be read directly when the host has no skill loader; shared
policy does not require loading the maintenance-role entry point.
Resolve `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT` (default `~/.wiki-master-vault`; with `WIKI_MASTER_REQUIRE_VAULT=1` set and no vault named, a script stops with exit 2 instead of using the default) and verify the expected
vault layout. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and
filesystem access are sufficient for the supported operations below; do not ask
the user to restart Obsidian as a prerequisite for all work.

## Layout and read scope

`raw/clippings/` holds captured evidence; `wiki/{sources,entities,concepts,syntheses,authored}/`
holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per
operation. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it. Reads do not
open operations, write logs, commit or refresh indexes. Before any authorized
mutation, read [operation completion](operations.md); before quoting or
synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).

Prefer bounded search and relevant MOCs to the generated catalog. Search
diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
distinct from factual review dates.

## Choose the supported channel

| Operation | Channel and fallback |
|---|---|
| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |
| Health, evidence routes, identity, relationships, drift coverage | Bundled filesystem helpers work without Obsidian. Do not gate them on `assertRunning`. Drift embeddings still require their backend. |
| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |

For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.
This policy is not Obsidian's documented maximum. If rejected before sending,
use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note
into many CLI writes or disable the guard. No fallback performs writes implicitly.
After an unavailable CLI or timeout, choose the supported fallback once; never
loop waiting for the app. **A timed-out mutation has an uncertain outcome.** Read
the exact target and check the intended effect before retrying or switching to
filesystem writes. An exit or timeout alone does not establish that nothing ran.
OS cleanup releases a lock after process death, but cannot prove a surviving CLI
child or an already-submitted Obsidian mutation finished. Inspect uncertain targets.

Validate resolved paths stay under the known root. Restrict searches to explicit
content directories; exclude `.recycle/`, dot folders, dependency trees and binary
originals. Do not recursively enumerate the entire user profile or scan a recycled
topic. Raw bodies remain immutable even during fallback. If target content changed
since it was read, reconcile it before writing; do not overwrite concurrent work.

## Shell portability

Examples elsewhere use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs"` as command
notation. Replace the placeholder with the actual installed absolute path before
execution, and set the vault for the operation's scope. Do not execute literal
angle-bracket placeholders or assume a relative `scripts/` path means the plugin.

PowerShell (restore any prior environment value):

```powershell
$wikiPriorVault = $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT
try {
  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = 'C:/absolute/path/to/vault'
  node 'C:/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Wiki health failed' }
} finally {
  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = $wikiPriorVault
}
```

POSIX shell (one command's environment only):

```sh
WIKI_MASTER_VAULT='/absolute/path/to/vault' node '/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
```

On Windows, use PowerShell or the Node wrapper for Obsidian; Git Bash can select
the GUI executable instead of `Obsidian.com` and return misleading empty output.
These reporting examples are read-only: do not open an operation or rebuild the
index merely to answer a question.

24	   state. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it.

26	   linking back to the `raw/` notes it derives from, plus `ai-generated: true`.
27	   **Exception: `wiki/authored/`** — original content with no `raw/` counterpart
28	   (advisory documentation, policy, house style) declares this explicitly via

30	   authorship (`true` if you drafted it, `false` if the human did) — the
31	   disclosure is about provenance, not about who wrote the words.

34	   paper over a gap with plausible text.

36	   own memory of a source are *claims, not authority*: verify every quote,
37	   figure, and attribution against the clipping in `raw/` before it lands on a

41	   outward from the one artifact that cannot drift.

43	   - It guarantees **fidelity, not truth** — a faithful clipping of a wrong page
44	     is still wrong; quality tiers and cross-clipping corroboration handle
45	     credibility.

47	     what the vault *holds*, not of what the author typed — don't trust it at
48	     character level.
49	   - A clipping's **silence proves "not supported here," never "false"** —
50	     record unsourced claims as unsourced (visibly, on the page) rather than
51	     asserting or deleting them. The vault cannot cite what it does not hold.

59	reported experiences and any inference that relies on them in the corresponding
60	section; do not blend the two platforms together or with higher-quality evidence.
61	This applies to source summaries, concepts, entities and syntheses, including
62	material reused through another wiki page. Even a summary of a single platform
63	source needs its heading. Raw clippings retain the captured content without rewriting.
64

66	do not turn a few comments into consensus, prevalence or established facts.
67	Disclose missing comments or reply context when the capture is incomplete;
68	do not claim a full thread was captured without verifying it. Upvotes do not
69	establish credibility.
70	
71	Keep Reddit and Medium citations and dependent conclusions out of the main factual
72	sections, opening summary and recommendations. A fact independently supported
73	by higher-quality evidence may appear there with those independent citations;
74	any platform comparison stays in its labeled section. Retain all provenance in
75	`sources:` frontmatter. Assess individual sources using the existing credibility
76	rubric; allowing capture does not automatically upgrade their credibility.
77	Official platform documentation and policy pages outside discussion threads or
78	Medium articles do not require these labels.

81	Narrative is licensed; dismissal is not. Three house rules govern every page:
82	
83	1. **Opposing viewpoints appear in their entirety** — in their own strongest
84	   terms, attributed to their holders — before any conclusion engages them.
85	   A viewpoint the page ends up arguing against gets the same care as one it
86	   endorses; weight follows the evidence the vault holds, and no viewpoint is
87	   waved off by tone (loaded verbs, scare quotes, "supposedly"). When sources
88	   conflict, keep the claims separate and attributed — never resolve them into
89	   one synthesized voice that erases the disagreement.

93	   (the wiki's own inference — say so explicitly, never state it in the
94	   page's neutral voice). Joining source A to source B to imply C is an
95	   *original* claim even when A and B are both cited.

97	   conclusion must be walkable back to `raw/`: `sources:` frontmatter, inline
98	   `[[wikilinks]]` to the source pages, and quotes verified per guardrail #5.
99	   A conclusion whose trail dead-ends is a defect, however good it reads.
100	
101	Per-type licenses (neutrality is a property of a page type, not of the vault):
102	- `raw/` — fidelity only; the evidence layer (guardrail #1, #5).
103	- `wiki/entities/` — **describe and only describe.** Convert opinions to
104	  attributed facts about who holds them; convert evaluations to the measurable
105	  facts beneath them. When tempted to interpret, link to a concept or
106	  synthesis instead.
107	- `wiki/concepts/` — claims with grounding. Assertive titles are allowed; the
108	  title's pressure is the point, and the body must support the claim under
109	  rules 1–3.
110	- `wiki/syntheses/` — the licensed narrative layer: weigh, judge, conclude —
111	  bounded by rules 1–3, and labeled as the wiki's synthesis.

114	  by design. Same full narrative license as syntheses; state recommendations
115	  directly. Rule 3 (breadcrumb to `raw/`) does not apply — there is deliberately
116	  nothing to trail, declared via `sources: []` rather than left silent.
117

119	
120	`citation-status: quarantined` is an explicit do-not-cite restriction, independent of credibility and character fidelity. Do not use `retired` for a page that merely leans on a quarantined clipping; that is `restricted`, and it stays under the evidence check. Preserve the restriction when reusing summaries; removing an item from triage is not permission to cite it. See [re-clipping and quarantine](../../../docs/reclipping.md).
121	
122	HTML clips may also carry `fidelity: partial` and `fidelity-checks: <count>`. The clipper compares recognized source headings, callouts, availability notices, API introductions and feature-list items with extracted text, plus whole normalized endpoint summaries and parameter rows, and literal supplied code examples in recognized REST layouts. Missing probes queue fidelity triage. `fidelity-ignored: <count>` records headings set aside as site chrome (a feedback widget, a sidebar); they open no triage, and their labels are printed when the clip is made. Inspect the triage issues before quoting affected material. Zero warnings is not proof of completeness: unrecognized structures, unselected UI tabs and content absent from supplied HTML are outside this check. See [HTML clipping fidelity](../../../docs/clipping-fidelity.md).
123	
124	A URL can have more than one capture. A recapture (`clip.mjs <url> --recapture`) is a second, dated clipping of the same page, written beside the first: its name and `title` end ` (recaptured YYYY-MM-DD)`, its `created` is the day it was made, and `recapture-of` names the newest capture it follows, as a vault path. The older clipping is never edited, so both are evidence of what the page said on their own dates, each with its own `source-hash`; cite the capture whose text you quote. See [recapture, saved pages and the decline and known-URL commands](../../../docs/clipping-fidelity.md#recapture-saved-pages-and-the-decline-and-known-url-commands-0870).

- **Role:** researcher.
- **Mode:** ingest named existing clippings. The request names one file, `raw/clippings/Beacon Study.md`, and says not to discover new sources. That rules out discovery, capture and global-backlog processing.
- **References loaded:**
  - `wiki-researcher/references/ingest.md`
  - `wiki-maintainer/references/access.md`
  - `wiki-maintainer/references/evidence.md`
- **Not loaded yet:**
  - `operations.md` is needed before the first authorized write.
  - `efficacy.md` is needed only if a concept, alias or relationship is created or merged.
  - `maintenance.md` is needed only for backlog or repair cases.

**Scope and approval boundaries**

- This was a routing probe, so I did not run the workflow, touch any vault, or run any commands.
- Scope would be exactly that one clipping. I would not expand it to the backlog or to new sources.
- Before opening an operation, I would resolve and read the exact path and check its metadata and hash. The steps are:
  - Check the hash-join report and existing source summaries. If a summary already records the clipping's `source-hash`, stop and report it as already ingested.
  - Exclude it if its `citation-status` is `quarantined`, `restricted` or `retired`, and report that separately.
  - Treat a missing hash as a repair issue. Do not invent one.

  - Open the operation, then write `wiki/sources/<slug>.md` with quoted `sources` wikilinks that use the exact clipping filename, plus `source-hashes`, using exact-path edits.
  - Never edit anything under `raw/`.
  - Apply the Reddit and Medium labeling rules if either platform applies.
  - Regenerate the index, write the log entry, validate, and commit.
  - Sync and verify the remote unless publication is held.
